name: Isotopic Approximation of Implicit Curves and Surfaces
definition: An algorithm that generates a piecewise linear approximation of implicit curves in R^2 and surfaces in R^3 that is regularly isotopic to the original manifold, meaning it has the same topology and can be continuously deformed into the original within the embedding space.
summary: Isotopic Approximation generates topologically correct piecewise linear meshes for implicit curves and surfaces using interval arithmetic to adaptively subdivide space without computing critical points.
